[[File:Alpiett.png|thumb|right|250px|Imperial Vice Admiral [[Alpiett Gredge]]]]

'''Vice Admiral''' was a rank in many navies. Vice Admirals were superior to [[Rear Admiral/Legends|Rear Admirals]], but inferior to the rank of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]]. Examples of Vice Admirals include [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], the former previous to his promotion to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]].

Within the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], Vice Admirals held a position of [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] when they were in charge of a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], a position of [[systems admiral]] (also known as commodore) when they commanded a [[systems force]] or a position of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] when they were in charge of a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]]. Vice Admiral ranked above Rear Admiral, and below Admiral.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
